notes.title: Prop Hunt Rumble - Patch Notes v0.1.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here's a Prop Hunt Rumble update, which fixes most of the bugs you've been reporting. Here's a list of the changes:

ADDED

 Experience gain animation at the end of the round


UPDATED

 Tab button look in the main menu and lobby


FIXED

 Various minor fixes and optimizations


We're excited to show you what's coming soon to Prop Hunt Rumble!

notes.title: Prop Hunt Rumble - Patch Notes v0.1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here's the third Prop Hunt Rumble update, which fixes most of the bugs you've been reporting. Here's a list of the changes:

ADDED

 Option to add a password to the match to make it private


UPDATED

 Removal of the old input system and some unused files


FIXED

 The scan key now binds correctly in the settings
 Fixed frame rate limit option not applying and saving correctly
 Various minor fixes and optimizations


We're excited to show you what's coming soon to Prop Hunt Rumble!

notes.title: Prop Hunt Rumble - Patch Notes v0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here's the second Prop Hunt Rumble update, which fixes most of the bugs you've been reporting. Here's a list of the changes:

ADDED

 Graphic setting for global illumination
 Added timer sound while seeker waits for props to hide


UPDATED

 Texture optimization for increased performance and reduced game size
 Optimization of runtime virtual textures
 Mesh optimization for all 3D models


FIXED

 Correction and optimization of numerous collisions
 Changing the volume of ambient sounds now works correctly
 User interface sounds are now well affected by volume changes
 Various minor corrections and optimizations


We'd like to wish you all a very happy holiday season again, and we're excited to show you what's coming soon to Prop Hunt Rumble!

notes.title: Prop Hunt Rumble - Patch Notes v0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here's the first Prop Hunt Rumble update, which fixes most of the bugs you've been reporting. Here's a list of the changes:

ADDED

 Props movement sounds
 Footsteps in the water for seekers
 Special icon for each sounboard sound
 User interface sounds
 Tooltip to indicate how to gain experience by pointing to the experience bar


UPDATED

 The ping of a server in the list was hidden because it was incorect in all circumstances
 Collisions between projectiles and certain elements have been fixed and improved with water


FIXED

 The scan no longer prevents footsteps from being played
 Collisions between scan and props have been fixed
 Main menu music now stops correctly when a player joins a game in progress
 Improvement and fixing of some user interfaces
 Various performance enhancements and optimization


We'd like to wish you all a very happy holiday season, and we're excited to show you what's coming soon to Prop Hunt Rumble!
